## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGLSurface> CreateGLSurface( const std::string& identifier, int x, int y, int width, int height, const GLSurfaceConfig& config = GLSurfaceConfig());   // Factory functions
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGLSurface> CreateGLSurface( int x, int y, int width, int height, const GLSurfaceConfig& config = GLSurfaceConfig());
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasGLSurface(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height);
UltraCanvasGLSurface(const std::string& identifier, float width, float height);
explicit UltraCanvasGLSurface(const std::string& identifier = "GLSurface");
UltraCanvasGLSurface(const GLSurfaceConfig& config, const std::string& identifier = "GLSurface", float x = 0, float y = 0, float width = 300, float height = 300);
UltraCanvasGLSurface(const UltraCanvasGLSurface&) = delete;
UltraCanvasGLSurface(UltraCanvasGLSurface&&) noexcept;
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### struct `GLSurfaceConfig`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `glVersionMajor` | `int glVersionMajor = 3` | OpenGL major version (default 3.3 Core) |
| `glVersionMinor` | `int glVersionMinor = 3` | OpenGL minor version |
| `coreProfile` | `bool coreProfile = true` | Use Core profile (vs Compatibility) |

| `blueBits` | `int blueBits = 8` | Blue channel bits |
| `alphaBits` | `int alphaBits = 8` | Alpha channel bits |
| `sRGB` | `bool sRGB = false` | Request sRGB framebuffer |
